verdict.rationale: Chroma documents built-in full-text search via $contains/$not_contains and regex matching combinable with metadata filtering, and mentions sparse/lexical BM25/SPLADE search on its marketing site, with community corroboration citing regex+trigram search for code-search use cases. However, this is substring/regex matching rather than true relevance-ranked keyword search (BM25/lexical) in the queryable API — the BM25/SPLADE claim appears only as a roadmap/marketing bullet without documented API details or independent verification of ranking quality. missing for 10: documented API/tutorial for BM25 lexical scoring and ranking, independent hands-on validation of full-text search quality vs dedicated search engines.
